look_here_first: Compare the flower directly with pearl milkvine: it is more bell-shaped, with mostly parallel longitudinal green lines that become netted only near the lobe tips/margins, and the inner corolla surface is visibly hairy.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: stems sparsely hairy to nearly glabrous

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: deeply cordate opposite leaves, basal lobes often overlapping

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: pale yellow-green campanulate corolla with darker longitudinal lines

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: five fleshy corona segments free nearly to base

key_traits.label: Milkweed vine training
key_traits.text: Use fused corolla plus corona/gynostegium and follicle armature; preserve modern genus placement even when older/source labels use Matelea.
